iti9:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti9:2.1: lobhaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
iti9:2.2: lobhaṃ ca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā’ti.
iti9:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
